macro_nlp.decision: Do not apply title/code event filtering. Existing 2025 fragments may support a clearly labeled exploratory sample analysis; they do not satisfy broad 2023-2026 news coverage. 2026 fixed NLP comparison is not runnable without timestamped 2026 macro text.
macro_nlp.no_zero_imputation: 2026 count 0 means no retrieved 2026 news rows exist; no missing-news sentiment/theme value is filled with numeric zero.
